intent.raw: Create a research dispatch for project ontologize: ingest what was done in the codex goldenquill client package worktree and branch, then synthesize a general solution for cyberalchemy's first product, which offers consulting on how to use ontology and DAG to improve a company's business intelligence and agent work.
intent.objective: Plan a governed research route that recovers the GoldenQuill client-package worktree and branch evidence (promotion record DAG, ontology/governance substrate, client-sendable packages, agent skills), extracts the reusable ontology-plus-DAG patterns, and distills them into a candidate productized consulting offer for CyberAlchemy without claiming it as a built product or promoting canonical Arcanum knowledge.
intent.operator_sentence: Read the GoldenQuill client-package work in source terms first, extract its ontology and DAG patterns, then translate them into a general CyberAlchemy consulting product for ontology- and DAG-driven business intelligence and agent work.

route_menu.context_hint: The selected route mirrors the autobayes research tower: recover source context first, scaffold a tower, fan out role-bound research, then distill an operator-facing synthesis. Here the 'source' is the GoldenQuill client-package worktree/branch, and the 'operator interface' is a CyberAlchemy consulting product offer.

items.label: Source-first product synthesis
items.description: Recover the GoldenQuill client-package evidence, scaffold the research tower, fan out ontology/DAG/BI/agent/productization lanes, then distill a candidate CyberAlchemy consulting product.

items.label: Product pitch first
items.description: Draft the consulting offer immediately and backfill evidence later; faster but weak on source-backed claims and reusable patterns.

items.label: Ontology vault first
items.description: Build a governed ontology vault from GoldenQuill before product synthesis; useful if knowledge-modeling rigor is the main blocker.

technique_overlays.trigger: The user asked to base the product on what was actually done in the GoldenQuill client-package worktree and branch, not on invented capabilities.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every product claim must trace to a concrete GoldenQuill artifact path or be explicitly marked as an analogy, hypothesis, or open residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route produces a CyberAlchemy product offer plus glossary and definitions that could be mistaken for shipped capabilities or canonical Arcanum knowledge.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The product synthesis is a candidate consulting offer; it may not promote canonical Arcanum vocabulary, claim the product is built, or commit pricing/contract terms without owner review.

steps.name: Recover GoldenQuill client-package worktree and branch evidence
stop_conditions: Block if the GoldenQuill client-package worktree cannot be inspected on the codex/goldenquill-client-package branch.
Flag if the promotion record DAG or governance docs are missing and record the gap as missing-source residue.

steps.name: Scaffold the ontologize research tower

capability_metadata.note: research-tower is an installed Arcanum skill but is not in the validator's narrow canonical set; treated as a candidate capability here.

convergence_criteria: The tower names corpus, pattern map, product closure plan, gates, and open residues.
The tower separates GoldenQuill source evidence from CyberAlchemy product hypotheses.
The tower speaks in Arcanum vocabulary while preserving GoldenQuill terms (promotion DAG, governance, council, logician).
stop_conditions: Block if the route grants promotion authority.
Flag if the tower lacks closure gates.

steps.name: Fan out role-bound extraction of ontology and DAG patterns

capability_metadata.note: robot-talks is an installed Arcanum multi-agent skill but is not in the validator's narrow canonical set; treated as a candidate capability here.

convergence_criteria: Each role returns source-backed findings with concrete GoldenQuill paths, open residue, and confidence.
Findings distinguish GoldenQuill source facts, reusable patterns, and CyberAlchemy product hypotheses.
The ontology lane and the DAG lane each name what transfers to a generic company BI and agent-work context.
stop_conditions: Block until the operator approves delegated research subagents.
Block synthesis if a role lacks source evidence.
Flag if a lane cannot find GoldenQuill evidence and classify the gap as missing-source residue.

steps.name: Build glossary and definitions for the consulting product

capability_metadata.note: feature-glossary is an installed Arcanum skill but is not in the validator's narrow canonical set; treated as a candidate capability here.

convergence_criteria: Each term states whether it is GoldenQuill source language, generic ontology/DAG/BI language, or a CyberAlchemy product coinage.
Each definition states status: source-backed, seed, analogy, candidate, or rejected.
Terms cover ontology, DAG, business intelligence, and agent-work as a client would hear them.
stop_conditions: Block canonical promotion of glossary or definitions.
Flag coinages that lack a source-backed or generic-practice basis.

steps.name: Synthesize the CyberAlchemy consulting product solution
convergence_criteria: The product names the offer, target buyer, problem, ontology-plus-DAG method, deliverables, engagement shape, and proof drawn from GoldenQuill.
Every method claim ties to an extracted GoldenQuill pattern or is marked as a hypothesis with a validation step.
The offer generalizes beyond GoldenQuill to a company's business intelligence and agent work.
stop_conditions: Block if the synthesis claims the product is already built or sold.
Block if it commits pricing, contracts, or client names without owner review.

steps.name: Validate dispatch, gates, and open residue
convergence_criteria: The dispatch validates against the dispatch-spec validator.
Open residue has named next objects and owners.
Next actions are executable and ordered.
stop_conditions: Flag if open residue lacks owner or next route.

steps.name: Prepare next-route handoff for product validation
stop_conditions: Ask operator approval before executing subagent fanout.
Defer building any consulting collateral until research closure.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The research spans GoldenQuill source recovery, ontology modeling, DAG/promotion governance, business-intelligence value, agent-work patterns, client packaging, and product synthesis across distinct lanes.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents keep source reading separate from product invention, so the CyberAlchemy offer stays traceable to concrete GoldenQuill evidence instead of drifting into wishful capability claims.
context: The source material is the codex/goldenquill-client-package worktree and branch, including a promotion record DAG and governance/ontology substrate.
The user wants a general consulting product, so one lane must explicitly generalize patterns beyond GoldenQuill.

roles.purpose: Extract how GoldenQuill models knowledge as an ontology/vault and what generalizes.
Extract the promotion record DAG and governance graph structure and its decision flow.
Identify where ontology and DAG produced business-intelligence value in GoldenQuill.
Extract how agents/skills use the ontology and DAG to do work in GoldenQuill.
Study the client-sendable package to learn how value was already framed for a buyer.
Generalize the patterns into a candidate CyberAlchemy consulting product.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the ontologize research fanout with ontology, DAG/governance, business-intelligence, agent-work, client-packaging, and productization roles over the GoldenQuill client-package worktree, returning source-backed receipts only?
receipt_requirements: source claims with concrete GoldenQuill artifact paths

agents.spawn_error: Not delegated as a separate subagent; the parent route ran synthesis inline to avoid duplicating the five lanes' receipts.
agents.residue: Productization synthesis was performed by the parent rather than a sibling agent.
agents.reroute: Executed inline by parent during synthesize-product-solution; output is PRODUCT.md.

validation: GoldenQuill client package, promotion DAG, skills, and decisions inspected read-only on branch codex/goldenquill-client-package.
Tower includes README, TOWER, L0 corpus, L1 pattern map, L2 product closure plan.
Five role-bound lanes returned source-backed findings; sixth role synthesized inline.
Each term marks origin (GoldenQuill / generic / coinage) and status (source-backed / seed / analogy / candidate).
Every capability claim tagged proven (with source) or hypothesis (with validation step).
No built/sold claims; no pricing, contracts, or named clients.
Dispatch validates against scripts/validate-dispatch.py; open residue and NEXT recorded.
Next route is decision-gate then task-session; product validation handoff named.

boundaries.contract: GoldenQuill client-package artifacts are read-only source evidence; this dispatch imports and cites them but does not modify the GoldenQuill project.
The CyberAlchemy product synthesis is a candidate offer until an owner approves it for client-facing use; no pricing, contracts, or commitments are authorized here.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Research and product artifacts may be written under projects/ontologize only unless a later approved task expands scope.
Read-only for this dispatch; no GoldenQuill writes.
No writes from this dispatch without explicit owner-review task.

promotion_splits.source: projects/ontologize candidate product, glossary, and definitions
promotion_splits.target: canonical Arcanum knowledge or client-facing CyberAlchemy collateral
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Every finding must distinguish GoldenQuill source facts, generic ontology/DAG/BI practice, reusable patterns, CyberAlchemy product hypotheses, and open questions.
The GoldenQuill project is read-only source evidence; this dispatch must not modify any GoldenQuill artifact.
The research artifact set must include README, TOWER, L0 corpus, L1 pattern map, L2 product closure plan, glossary, definitions, PRODUCT, open residue, and NEXT.
Recommended research subagent execution requires explicit operator approval before delegated research runs.
The product synthesis must mark every capability claim as proven by GoldenQuill evidence or as a hypothesis with a validation step, and must not claim the product is built or sold.
Research outputs may propose candidate mappings and a candidate product but must not promote glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, memory, or runtime authority, nor commit client-facing terms.
The dispatch must pass the dispatch-spec validator before being treated as handoff-ready.

promotion_guardrails: Do not modify the GoldenQuill project; treat it as read-only source evidence.
Do not promote ontologize terms into canonical Arcanum vocabulary without owner review.
Do not treat the candidate product as a built or sold offering.
Do not commit pricing, contracts, or named client engagements without owner review.
Do not execute research subagents without explicit operator approval.
